requirements.criterion: Trimmed nonempty Unicode names are greeted; blank input is rejected.
Initialization validates identity, changes configuration and clears inherited approvals while preserving source; CI rejects a mismatched actual repository identity.
Explicit authorized setup applies strict PR/host/admin protection, exposes inspection/API/incomplete-response failures and preserves existing rules for explicit reconciliation.
requirements.gap: Real hosted protection setup and account-plan differences need current API evidence.

requirements.criterion: UI expert proposal precedes implementation; material ambiguity waits for user, exact authorized corrections proceed. Rendered acceptance is separate.
requirements.gap: Policy/tabletop review only. No product UI, visual baseline or measured latency is supplied.

requirements.criterion: Concrete case mappings, canonical test fingerprints, scenario dimensions and gaps stay fresh for test additions/edits/removals.
requirements.gap: Default inventory supports Python unittest. Other language/framework adapters require implementation and verification.

requirements.criterion: Two distinct fresh-agent approvals bind to canonical staged/committed candidate and gate real pushes; changed content rejects.
requirements.gap: Records cannot authenticate identity/independence. Actual fresh reviews and hosted PR protection are separate evidence.

requirements.criterion: Preserve bytes/originals and reject unsafe, corrupt, missing, unexpected, changed or overwritten archives. Availability and failed-run scope stay explicit.
requirements.gap: Live Actions retention/expiry/download and durable external availability are not proved by local archive tests.

requirements.criterion: Argument-array commands preserve literals/failure logs; missing/invalid/source-mismatched results fail and actual statuses remain separate.
requirements.gap: Configured reference stack only; product build/E2E/device adapters require explicit setup.

requirements.criterion: Current host counts, coverage/gaps, reports, artifacts and archive/source hashes bind before publish; stale reviews, mismatches and existing release refuse. Exact publication export/import preserves arbitrary configured extensions and dot-prefixed filenames without intermediate directories.
requirements.gap: Publication tests use synthetic local fixtures and mocked GitHub. Real Actions/release publication must be recorded separately.

requirements.criterion: Concise README, separate changelog, onboarding, shared design/architecture and feature diagrams retain valid links and explicit verification limits. Filesystem aliases normalize consistently so Windows short/long paths report link findings without crashing.
requirements.gap: Rendered diagram inspection and novice onboarding are manual; no application visual/performance or device claim.
